description:
Humanizer AI rewrites AI drafts so they sound like you. It replaces stiff phrases, cuts repetition, and varies sentence length while keeping your facts and meaning.

Paste an email, blog post, or product description. Tell Humanizer AI how you want it to sound and which words to keep.

If an AI detector flags your writing by mistake, Humanizer AI helps you rephrase it so it sounds human.

defaultPrompt: Humanize this AI draft so it sounds like me
An AI detector flagged my paragraph. Help me make it sound human.

positive.description: Basic English editing. Setup: connected test account with sufficient credits. No attachments required.
positive.prompt: Make this sound natural: We are reaching out in order to inform you that the meeting will take place on Friday at 10 AM.
positive.expected_behavior: Call humanize_text with the complete supplied text and language=EN-US. Preserve Friday and 10 AM and return a readable rewrite. Base the final response on the returned rewrite; report any authentication or credit error without claiming success.

positive.description: Preserve Markdown. Setup: connected test account with sufficient credits. No attachments required.
positive.prompt:
Make this text read naturally while preserving Markdown:
## Update
- **Launch:** Friday
- Read [the guide](https://example.com/guide) before joining.
positive.expected_behavior: Call humanize_text with the complete supplied text and language=EN-US. Preserve heading, list, bold text, link target, and launch date. Base the final response on the returned rewrite; report any authentication or credit error without claiming success.

positive.description: Keep specified words. Setup: connected test account with sufficient credits. No attachments required.
positive.prompt: Make this text sound natural, but keep AcmeCloud and Project Orion unchanged: AcmeCloud is pleased to announce that Project Orion will be available to our customers next month.
positive.expected_behavior: Call humanize_text with the complete supplied text and language=EN-US. Set frozen_words to include AcmeCloud and Project Orion; preserve both exact phrases and next month. Base the final response on the returned rewrite; report any authentication or credit error without claiming success.

positive.description: French input. Setup: connected test account with sufficient credits. No attachments required.
positive.prompt: Reformule naturellement en français : Nous souhaitons vous informer que votre commande sera livrée mardi.
positive.expected_behavior: Call humanize_text with the complete supplied text and language=FR. Return French text preserving the Tuesday delivery fact. Base the final response on the returned rewrite; report any authentication or credit error without claiming success.

positive.description: British English input. Setup: connected test account with sufficient credits. No attachments required.
positive.prompt: Rewrite naturally in British English: Our organisation would like to apologise for the delay and confirm that the colour samples will arrive on Monday.
positive.expected_behavior: Call humanize_text with the complete supplied text and language=EN-GB. Keep British English, the apology, and Monday arrival. Base the final response on the returned rewrite; report any authentication or credit error without claiming success.

negative.description: No source text. Expected: Ask the user to supply the text; do not call humanize_text without source text.
negative.prompt: Make my writing sound more natural.

negative.description: Unsupported sending action. Expected: Explain that the plugin cannot send email. Offer to draft text; do not claim an email was sent or call a plugin tool to send it.
negative.prompt: Send an email to my manager saying I will be late.

negative.description: Unsupported account deletion. Expected: Explain that account deletion is outside these tools and direct the user to account support; do not invoke humanize_text, search, fetch, or detect_ai to delete data or claim deletion.
negative.prompt: Delete my Humanize AI account and all my saved documents.

publication.release_notes: Renamed the plugin to Humanizer AI.
